clips.name: planner
clips.detail: Controlled browser clock, one screenshot per33/33/34ms, ordinary UI actions; no injected game state. Original150-frame target stopped at screenshot timeout; retained complete125-frame prefix only.
clips.scope: Planner only; not a flown mission or measured ephemeris.

captureNotes: Destination selector and builder captured at 1600×900; flight captured at 1280×720 to reduce software-GPU load.
Planner retained 125 complete frames after a screenshot timeout; no frames interpolated or repeated to extend it.
Physical ascent initially runs1× through the 100 m handover; existing visible10× game warp then activates. Output playback remains1×.
Staging omitted at editor request after complete 10 s ascent source; footage does not show or imply stage separation.
Root separately owns Solar System and docking capture files and their provenance.
limitations: Controlled-clock frame capture removes recorder timing loss; scene-motion quality still requires decoded-frame QA.
Integrated Moon ascent and separately initialized terminal exercises must remain distinguishable.
